From the photographic archive

Elements Sushi

80 Clapham High Street, London SW4 7UL

Japanese restaurant

A moment on the high street

What the photograph records

The former Elements Sushi restaurant at 80 Clapham High Street, London SW4 7UL, photographed on 3 April 2026 after closure. Its bright yellow fascia and red sushi logos remain above the glass frontage, with posters covering the central doors.

Photographed
3 April 2026
Recorded state
Vacant when photographed
Business type
Japanese restaurant

This record describes the premises on the photograph date. Later changes may not yet be included in the archive.

A few dates in the story

  1. 3 July 2024 Published source

    Elements Sushi: opening announced

    This Is Clapham published an article announcing that Elements Sushi had opened in Clapham, following its Streatham branch. This is the article's publication date; the exact opening day is not established.

    Opening announcement from This Is Clapham ↗
  2. 3 April 2026 Documented

    Elements Sushi: closed by this date

    The project photographer confirms Elements Sushi had ceased trading at this address by the time this photograph was taken. The exact closing date is unknown.
